def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""

    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    # divider: full row or column of one non-bg color
    div = None  # ('h', i) or ('v', j)
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg: div = ('h', i)
    if div is None:
        for j in range(w):
            col = [grid[i][j] for i in range(h)]
            if len(set(col)) == 1 and col[0] != bg: div = ('v', j)
    shape = {(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w)
             if grid[i][j] not in (bg, 2) and not (div[0]=='h' and i==div[1]) and not (div[0]=='v' and j==div[1])}
    sc = grid[min(i for i, j in shape)][min(j for i, j in shape if i == min(k for k, l in shape))]
    color = next(grid[i][j] for i, j in sorted(shape))
    out = [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # place shape adjacent to divider
    top = min(i for i, j in shape); bot = max(i for i, j in shape)
    left = min(j for i, j in shape); right = max(j for i, j in shape)
    if div[0] == 'h':
        di = div[1]
        if top > di:   # shape below divider, slide up
            shift = top - (di + 1)
            cells = {(i - shift, j) for i, j in shape}
        elif bot < di:
            shift = bot - (di - 1)
            cells = {(i - shift, j) for i, j in shape}
        else:
            cells = shape
        for i, j in cells: out[i][j] = color
        # 8 line on far side of shape, full width
        line = max(i for i, j in cells) + 1
        out[line] = [8]*w
    else:
        dj = div[1]
        if left > dj:
            shift = left - (dj + 1)
            cells = {(i, j - shift) for i, j in shape}
        elif right < dj:
            shift = right - (dj - 1)
            cells = {(i, j - shift) for i, j in shape}
        else:
            cells = shape
        for i, j in cells: out[i][j] = color
        line = max(j for i, j in cells) + 1
        for i in range(h): out[i][line] = 8
    return out
